verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents the assistant remembering context from earlier chats and applying it in new conversations. The closest items are adjacent: indexing connected email and data for later searches, storing materials in the Vault, and proactively following up on dropped threads. None of these is a documented cross-conversation chat memory capability, so none earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations
